QuestInfo.name: [Stellar Detectives] The Tiger and the Dragon
QuestInfo.0: All of the detectives' animal friends have been rescued, except Lingling. Will the search for Lingling be a roaring success?
QuestInfo.1: Lingling was altered further than even Tutu and Nenne.  She went berserk, and must be subdued.
QuestInfo.2: The Stellar Detectives were able to subdue Lingling. What happened next?
